bio: >
  Marley is a PhD student whose research focuses on phytoplankton and bacterial community networks in estuarine and saltmarsh systems. She is interested in understanding how phytoplankton community composition changes in concert with other microbes, and how those changes relate to carbon cycling and other ecosystem functions. Marley is co-advised by Dr. Elizabeth Harvey, and her work focuses on combining molecular techniques and bioinformatics with traditional and imaging flow cytometry.
